PARAM:p_ik.meaning: destruction probability of weapon platform/interceptor i against target k

PARAM:q_jk.meaning: tracking probability of sensor platform j against target k

PARAM:c_i_W.meaning: cost of launching/using interceptor or weapon platform i

PARAM:c_j_S.meaning: cost of activating sensor platform j

PARAM:A0.meaning: overall storage of interceptors / total ammunition baseline

VAR:x_ik.meaning: 1 if weapon platform/interceptor i is assigned to target k; 0 otherwise

VAR:y_jk.meaning: 1 if sensor platform j tracks target k; 0 otherwise

DERIVED:P_k.meaning: destruction probability of target k from assigned weapons

DERIVED:Q_k.meaning: tracking probability of target k from assigned sensors

DERIVED:used_interceptors.meaning: number of interceptors used in the current round

OBJ:O1.meaning: negative normalized threat elimination efficiency; minimizing O1 maximizes elimination

OBJ:O3.meaning: interceptor consumption, equivalent to preserving reserved strength

CON:C1.meaning: each target must be assigned at least two weapons/interceptors

CON:C2.meaning: each target must be tracked by at least one sensor

CON:C3.meaning: each weapon/interceptor can be assigned to at most one target in the round

SEMANTIC:unsupported_hard_target_require.meaning: hard target-required-effect threshold not in the paper model

SEMANTIC:unsupported_pombde_mapping_vari.meaning: POMBDE mapping variables as formulation variables

SEMANTIC:unsupported_planted_pareto_solu.meaning: planted Pareto solution or algorithm population in public input

algorithm_boundary: POMBDE, differential evolution mapping, Pareto-optimal matching and heuristic initialization are solution algorithms, not formulation constraints
